title: STAIR: Improving Safety Alignment with Introspective Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and uses introspective reasoning to identify and mitigate ethical risks in LLM responses. It specifically benchmarks on safety datasets and includes qualitative examples in the appendix where the model performs 'Ethical Evaluation' and identifies 'Ethical Considerations' to refuse harmful queries related to deepfakes, hate speech, and human trafficking.
